visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus is on the long, slender neck and the 'interlocking needle-teeth' protruding from the jaws, positioned completely parallel to the frame edge.

environment.biota: The schools of small prehistoric fish and 'Ivory' limestone outcrops are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to maintain a clean, measurable silhouette line.

visual_logic.pose: The marine reptile is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original stationary rock-basking pose is converted into a level, straight cruising path, allowing the fanged skull, elongated slender neck, streamlined torso, webbed limbs (flattened to the camera plane), and tail to extend end-to-end to track flawlessly alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
